description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git operations involving pathnames with funny characters. It sets up test cases, performs Git commands like update-index, write-tree, ls-files, and diff, and verifies that filenames with special characters are handled correctly in various Git commands.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Function used to define a successful test case with a specific description.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script execution.
